subject: Tranche unlock schedule & VAT coverage for annual commitment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Larsson <sophie.larsson@brightlane.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tranche unlock schedule & VAT coverage for annual commitment

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To keep the activation and accounting work low-friction on both sides, we put together a proposed tranche/unlock cadence for BrightLane’s annual committed prepay (deal BL-2028-0921). Draft attached. Key points: 

- Proposed invoices: 4 x quarterly tranches (Aug 1, Nov 1, Feb 1, May 1). Each invoice will be for 25% of the committed amount and will be labelled with the tranche ID for straightforward ledger reconciliation.
- Drawdown window: customer may request per-tranche drawdowns across a 30-day window after invoice date; Redwood will apply credits to usage per the attached drawdown mapping.
- VAT handling: we’ve started a country-by-country coverage matrix (attached). We flagged Sweden and Germany as items that may require reverse-charge or evidence collection.

Can you confirm: 
1) The legal entity and purchase order details we should put on the invoice (see placeholder in the spreadsheet).
2) Whether BrightLane prefers quarterly invoices to show full net amount (we’ll include VAT handling notes) or prefers split invoices per country entity.
3) Who on your finance team should receive the monthly drawdown notifications (we’ll send a usage + balance file on the 5th of each month).

Next steps I propose: I’ll circulate the finalized cadence once we have your legal entity and VAT number. After sign-off, we’ll generate the DocuSign commitment and schedule the first tranche invoice for Aug 1.

Attachments: 2028-annual-tranche-schedule.xlsx (xlsx), EU-VAT-coverage-matrix.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Karthik
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for this and for the clear draft. Quick answers below: 

1) Invoices should be made out to: BrightLane AB (Reg. no: 556677-8899)
   VAT: SE559988776601
   Billing address: Drottninggatan 12, 111 51 Stockholm, Sweden

2) We prefer a single quarterly invoice showing the net amount with a VAT line where applicable; for Sweden the reverse charge should apply if Redwood confirms cross-border service treatment. If you believe local registration will be required, flag it now.

3) Please send monthly drawdown notifications to finance@brightlane.com and cc me.

Also — we will need the invoice to reference the HubSpot deal id for internal tracking (BL-2028-0921). Final sign-off for DocuSign will come from our CFO (cc’d on future threads).

Regards,

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear thread. Quick tax / ops confirmation from my side after reviewing Sophie’s details and our EU-VAT matrix: 

- VAT position: For BrightLane AB (Sweden) we can apply reverse-charge on cross-border SaaS/inference services. No immediate Swedish VAT registration required for Redwood, provided we collect and retain the customer VAT number + contract evidence. Please confirm the CFO signs the DocuSign to close the audit trail.

- Invoice cadence: we will issue 4 invoices (Aug 1, Nov 1, Feb 1, May 1). Each will include: net amount, a VAT line with notation ‘Reverse charge – customer liable’, the HubSpot deal id BL-2028-0921 in the invoice reference, and the tranche ID in the invoice line description.

- Drawdown notifications: Redwood Ops will push a monthly usage & balance file on the 5th of each month to finance@brightlane.com (cc Karthik). That file will also include remaining committed balance per tranche.

- Ledger tagging: Marissa/Neha — tag revenue under deferred_prepaid_tranche and include tranche ID for reconciliation. Kimberly will send the final invoice templates and the GL mapping spreadsheet in a follow-up email.

Attachments: 2028-annual-tranche-schedule.xlsx (finalized), EU-VAT-coverage-matrix.csv (final), BrightLane-DocuSign.pdf (DocuSign envelope to send).

Next steps: Karthik — once Sophie confirms CFO sign-off date, I’ll queue the first invoice. Sophie — please confirm whether the CFO will sign by July 31 so we can hit the Aug 1 invoice.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
